title: Status Wall
emptyHint: Create a web server, a database, a Minecraft or game server in Hostwerk.
stale: As of {time} – refreshing doesn’t work right now
kioskHint: Open it in the browser of the second screen or tablet – read only, with a full screen button. Options: ?theme=light, ?size=compact or ?size=wall, ?stopped=0, ?group=0, ?lang=de.
kioskOff: For a second screen or a tablet there is an own address without sign-in. Switch on “Share the kiosk wall without sign-in” in the settings – then anyone with the address sees names and state of your services (no ports or addresses, no buttons).
up.emptyText: Under Production → Monitoring you add addresses that Hostwerk checks regularly.
up.pubHint: Visitors can see without signing in whether your services are running – only names, state, availability and history.
up.noRemote: For a link from outside, switch on remote access (Going live → Remote access) – or place the page into a website below.
up.rotateHint: New link: the old one stops working.
up.introPh: e.g. Here you can see whether the shop and the Minecraft server are running.
up.showUrlsHint: Otherwise visitors only see the names.
up.whichChecksHint: Unticked = stays private. A display name replaces the internal name.
up.siteHint: Hostwerk writes index.html and status.json into this folder every minute – for example htdocs/status of your website. That way the page runs on your own web server and domain.
